RETROSPECTIVE ARCHITECTURE DECISION · 11 OCTOBER 2026

ADR-0010: Treat capacity results as models and targets

Status

Accepted analysis method; measured database targets pending

Context

Planning needs to address 50M parties and 100M relationships without implying a full-size database has been benchmarked.

Decision

Keep analytic cardinality/storage, sampled queue simulations, actual OPA component timings and future service SLO targets explicitly separate. Preserve assumptions, seeds, results and validation scripts.

Alternatives

Label simulated p95/p99 as production performance; provision solely by row count.

Consequences

Skew, sharing density, graph size, retained history and recovery headroom can dominate. Targets are gates to measure, not promises.

Evidence

scale/assumptions.json; scale/results; scale/simulate.py; scale/validate.py

Gate

Replace assumptions with regional measurements; benchmark foreground tails under bulk load and failure recovery.
